Secure module call argument layouts and full error encodings beyond busy, resumable and success cases shown.
Virtual processor metadata field encodings and posted interrupt evaluation details.
Guest physical mapping initiation path and measurement chunk size definition.

findings.text: Guest ENCLS interception validates host and guest SGX readiness plus paging before dispatching recognized secure enclave leaves to dedicated handlers, with unready guests receiving fault injection and unexpected leaves surfacing as unknown exits.
In this configuration the host SGX enable is statically cleared and the SGX header carries a conventional include guard.
Failed host secure module calls mark the owning virtual machine as bugged once, emit a rate limited diagnostic identifying the call and operands, and propagate a boolean failure indication.
Private versus shared address discrimination uses frame numbers derived from guest address bits forty seven and fifty one for distinct paging depths.
Diagnostic helpers for failed virtual processor metadata reads and writes are externally visible and record the associated virtual machine as bugged while logging class, field and status.
Host wide capability information is held in a single static pointer to immutable system data.
The supported attribute set contains solely SEPT VE disable.
Transactional memory availability for trusted domains combines the HLE and RTM hardware feature indicators.
Absence of a CPUID subleaf is encoded as an all ones thirty two bit sentinel.
Guest setup of event notification interrupt is signaled by the second bit of an info word.
A global mutex serializes management operations while a per CPU list tracks virtual processors currently associated for flush coordination.
Private memory operations that contend on busy operands coordinate through the MMU lock in write mode plus a zap wait flag and a request forcing peers outside guest mode before retrying once.
Flush coordination bundles a virtual processor reference with a status holder for cross CPU propagation.
Cache writeback helper allows up to ten thousand secure call attempts.
Physical memory cache writeback uses a bounded retry discipline that resumes after interruptible returns and treats a no work indication as success, flagging any residual failure as fatal.
Domain key configuration runs in a worker context and converts any secure module failure into an input output error while marking the domain bugged.
Pending interrupt visibility for protected APIC honors posted interrupt state, then only for halted guests with interrupts enabled consults non architectural state for a pending flag.
User return metadata pairs a register identifier with a slot index and a reset value, with a static table covering SYSCALL_MASK, STAR, LSTAR and TSC_AUX and a conventional mask default.
Exit state availability advertises the two exit info words together with the full general purpose set from accumulator through extended registers eight to fifteen.
Preserved debug controls across trusted entry comprise branch trace, performance monitor freeze on counter overflow, and freeze in system management mode.
Hypercall and generic unknown call completions propagate the user space return value into the guest visible return code channel and request guest re entry.
Guest physical mapping progresses in chunks capped at two megabytes.

Mapping of guest physical ranges advances a cursor bounded by start and end markers, translating transient versus invalid host outcomes into retry versus operand error guest statuses and yielding to pending events.
Port input output completions clear output transfer counts and deliver emulated input values through the guest visible return channel.
Memory mapped input output read completion copies the serviced bytes into the guest return channel and records a read trace.
Retrieval of call info block completion forwards the host provided status plus four data words into the entry argument area.

Leaf private mappings accept only single page granularity with full access expectation, selecting initial add versus incremental augment based on domain runnability under a memory ordering barrier that pairs with finalization.
Non leaf secure table installation resolves the child table through its external backing page after validating level linkage and base frame, then issues the secure module table add.

Tracking and leaf removal require write ownership of the memory management lock, skip tracking before runnability, serialize epoch advancement with forced exits, and order block, track, remove and cache flush operations.
Private entry updates dispatch on presence of old versus new entries, removing, installing intermediate tables, or installing leaves as appropriate with validation of the new presence.

Mirror table teardown expects the domain key already released, and on unexpected assignment or reclaim failure the backing page is intentionally leaked and the pointer cleared to avoid access to encrypted memory.
Metadata readability masks reserve upper ranges starting at bit seven for leaf and subleaf selectors, spanning through bits thirty and thirty one respectively.
Domain state mutation acquires the virtual machine mutex outermost, then all virtual processor mutexes, then the slot mutex, releasing in reverse, with failure unwinding to an error pointer.
Post population of guest memory uses a slot protected scratch source page valid only during private mapping and optionally extends measurement in fixed size chunks after successful insertion.

Trusted domain container embeds the generic virtual machine object plus accounting, key identifier, lifecycle state, attributes, extended features, time offsets, module control, scratch source pointer and zap wait coordination flag.
Domain lifecycle progresses from uninitialized through initialized to runnable.

Trusted virtual processor container embeds generic and vendor processor state plus exit qualification, faulting address, entry arguments, module control, CPU linkage, entry result, lifecycle state and mapping cursor bounds.
Per processor lifecycle distinguishes uninitialized from initialized.
Trusted domain header is protected by a conventional include guard.
Host TDX enable is a post initialization immutable boolean.
